examples.name: Default
examples.summary: `LogView.Header` + `LogView.Content` over a realistic deploy log. Search filters lines and highlights matches in the body.

examples.name: Borderless
examples.summary: With `:bordered="false"` the shell drops its own outline and corner radius so it sits flush inside a surface that already frames it — an accordion panel, a drawer, a card. Internal dividers (the header and footer edges) are unaffected. Left on, the two frames would nest and read as a box inside a box.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: While `loading` is set, `LogView.Content` replaces the log body with a centered spinner and the `loadingLabel` text.

examples.name: Levels
examples.summary: A function's test-run log: each line has a `level` and its run offset in `time`, and `levels` on the root puts one toggle per level in the header with the count of lines at that level. Pressing a toggle filters the log to that level (`v-model:level`), pressing it again shows every level; `warn` and `error` rows are tinted and keep the level in text.

examples.name: Empty
examples.summary: A log with no lines shows the package empty state ("No log lines yet."). A search that matches nothing shows "No line matches …" with a Clear search action instead.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: `disabled` keeps the lines readable but locks the search, the level toggles and the copy control.

examples.name: WithFooter
examples.summary: `LogView.Footer` closes the shell with a summary line and an action, below the scrolling body.
